name: WestJet Vacations
source: Sunwing component-library: packages/design-tokens/tokens/wvi/typography.json (sizes, line heights, font) and packages/wvi-components/src/mixins/typography.scss (which weight each style uses). Copied 2026-11-26.
note: The tokens have one fixed size per style. The playground uses it as the desktop size (max), works out a mobile size (min) with the shrink rule unless a style sets its own "mobile" size, and sets preferred = size ÷ desktop width, so the text reaches its desktop size at that width.

shrink.about: On the smallest screen, a style loses this % of the size it has above `above` px (body size). Styles at or below `above` keep one size.
